snippet.title: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental Official Trailer #incremental #incrementalgame
snippet.description:
Sweep your cursor through swarms of data packets and turn them into cash. Spend it on racks, GPUs and drones. Keep it cool, keep it powered, and grow your company from one laptop into AGI.

Play the free demo on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5148350/

Wishlist on Steam, the full game comes out on 2 November 2026: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5145270/Silicon_Sprint_Data_Center_Incremental/
